# A subdirectory may hold its own Go package that does not embed its
# templates while a parent package does. muxt fmt formats a template
# with the package that embeds it: the parent's layout.gohtml makes .x
# preserve whitespace, so its interior is kept as written.

! muxt fmt -l templates/page.gohtml
cmp stdout want-list.txt
muxt fmt templates/page.gohtml
stdout '(?m)^\t<p>a</p>$'
stdout '\n  keep   me\n</div>\n'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.24
-- m.go --
package m

import "embed"

//go:embed templates/*.gohtml
var templates embed.FS
-- templates/templates.go --
package templates
-- templates/layout.gohtml --
{{define "head"}}<style>.x{white-space:pre}</style>{{end}}
-- templates/page.gohtml --
<section class="y">
<div class="x">
  keep   me
</div>
<p>a</p>
</section>
-- want-list.txt --
templates/page.gohtml
